propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py resolves only when scripts/ is on sys.path, causing ModuleNotFoundError when test files are run as subsets independent of full CI session.

Subset test runs of tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py fail with ModuleNotFoundError while full CI passes because CI's conftest.py inserts scripts/ onto sys.path at collection time, creating a process-wide side effect that leaks into later modules.

Fix uses explicit sys.path.insert derived from __file__ immediately above each bare sibling import, making resolution invocation-independent and idempotent, following the pattern established in jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py.

New guard test tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py AST-scans scripts/ for bare imports of sibling modules and verifies each is preceded by required sys.path.insert, plus a subprocess check that affected test modules collect when run alone.
